entities.summary: Ivan "Ike" Taylor is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL) in the fourth round of the 2003 NFL draft, and spent his entire 12-year career in Pittsburgh. He played college football for the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns.
